extraction.disclaimer_span: We do not offer every plan available in your area. Currently we represent 26 organizations which offer 3,740 products in your area. Please contact Medicare.gov or 1-800-MEDICARE to get information on all of your options.
extraction.soa_span: I've sent the Scope of Appointment to your email so we can go over specific plans. Can you sign it while we're on the line?

composition.summary: The agent followed all compliance rules, including delivering the disclaimer before discussing benefits and collecting the Scope of Appointment before scheduling the appointment.
composition.coaching_note: Great job, Marcus! You adhered to all the necessary compliance steps. One suggestion: consider mentioning the scope of appointment more explicitly in the email to ensure the customer understands the next steps.

crm_record.next_step: Follow up with customer via email to confirm receipt of Scope of Appointment and set expectations for the appointment.
